title: Screen: clarify when to skip or batch formal planning
hypothesis: One planning clarification reduces standalone plan model rounds on bounded existing-code changes without losing correctness or discovery needed by layered work.
falsified_if: Any artifact, scope, verification, or protocol check fails; unchanged planning behavior is nonactivation and mixed efficiency evidence parks the candidate.
local_evidence: In the SAM screen LCA generated a standalone update_plan response taking 14.612 seconds before a response containing all four mutations. The user authorized a six-run test on existing-code fixtures. Both arms include the current realistic-test guidance; no runtime-selection or tool changes are mixed in.

task_suffixes.simple_prompt: This task is self-contained; do not browse or use external network services.
task_suffixes.existing_codebase_edit: File scope: change only checkout/models.py, checkout/config.py and checkout/pricing.py. Do not add files. This task is self-contained; do not browse or use external network services.
task_suffixes.multifile_order_cancellation: File scope: change only orders/__init__.py, orders/api.py, orders/models.py, orders/repository.py and orders/service.py. Do not add files. This task is self-contained; do not browse or use external network services.

deterministic_outcomes: exact additional planning instruction with baseline/project instructions and tools preserved
efficiency_outcomes: standalone plan model rounds: a response containing update_plan and no other tool calls
output tokens and all-attempt estimated cost
decision_rule: Seed 920. Six serial screen-only runs, one per arm on simple_prompt and two coding tasks; simple control first, randomized coding-task and within-pair arm order. Maximum six launches, $2.50 between-run standard-equivalent cost threshold (one-run overshoot possible), 600 active worker seconds. Stop after a task or protocol/activation failure and preserve all usage. Advance only if all six pass, treatment has at least one fewer aggregate standalone coding plan round, aggregate coding latency is at least 10% lower, neither coding task is more than 10% slower, and aggregate coding output tokens do not rise more than 10%. Otherwise park and describe nonactivation/tradeoffs. No standalone plans in either arm makes this cohort uninformative about that mechanism, regardless of timing. A positive screen justifies fresh replication only, not production promotion. Original grades remain unchanged; inspect plan batches and raw provider instructions after the run. No defaults change.
